title: Encumbering stone
description: Minecraft mod that adds customizable Encumbering Stone from game Terraria
body:
Vanila+ Minecraft mod that adds customizable Encumbering Stone from game Terraria.

Once activated Encumbering Stone stops player from picking up items.

You can **add Exceptions** for items you can pick up with activated Encumbering Stone.                          
There are 9 exceptions for _Basic_, 18 exceptions for _Enhanced_, 27 exceptions for _Upgraded_ Encumbering stone.    
You can craft as many Encumbering Stones as you like but having two Encumbering Stones in your inventory at once - makes you heavier, which makes you **50% slower** and having even more Encumbering Stones in your inventory **completely stops you** from moving.

- **Right click** in hand or in GUI to **Activate**.
- **Shift + Right click** to **Manage exceptions**.

![Encumbering Stone GUI ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/104c2ee7b3af48fe452638e1f9fadc04e39164c1_0.webp)

_v2 changes: Now you're able to put Encumbering Stones in the Hopper to sort the items passing through it.
Once you put activated Encumbering Stone inside a Hopper it stops Hopper from picking up or sending out items that aren't added to Encumbering Stone exceptions._
